release_notes:
Release 1.0.32 — order-form polish, centered admin footer, registration address fields, faster order status updates

Order form
- Bulk IMEI "N in list" count now stays on one line (no wrapping), and the entry form (IMEI/File/Server) is verified to render cleanly on small/mobile screens.

Admin dashboard
- Footer copyright is now centered within the visible footer area and re-centers smoothly when the left menu is expanded or collapsed.

Registration
- Added address fields to sign-up — Address Line 1, Address Line 2 (optional), City, State/Province, Zip/Postal Code — mapped to the same customer columns that My Profile edits and that the PayPal/Stripe "Add Credits" billing/shipping flow prefills, so the address is consistent everywhere. Admins can disable any field or toggle its Mandatory flag under Registration Fields.

Performance
- Marking an order complete/cancelled/resubmitted now returns immediately: the customer email, SMS and push notification are sent AFTER the response is flushed (background), instead of blocking the admin action on SMTP/Twilio/push round-trips.
